candidates.change_summary: Replace `withdraw(address(this).balance)` with a fixed small value like `withdraw(1)` so the owner only withdraws 1 wei instead of the full balance.
Delete the `withdraw(address(this).balance)` statement so withdrawAll does nothing and the balance never decreases.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier on `withdrawAll` so anyone can call it and drain the contract.
Replace `withdraw(address(this).balance)` with `withdraw(0)` so withdrawAll transfers zero wei to the owner.
Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call withdraw.
Replace the transfer call with a call that sends zero value regardless of _value parameter.
Delete the transfer statement so no funds are sent.
Change recipient from msg.sender to owner address, keeping the withdrawal amount the same.
Replace the onlyOwner modifier to always allow execution by removing the require statement.
Remove the revert on call failure so that sendMoney always succeeds externally even if the call fails.
Delete the low-level call statement so that no ETH is ever sent.
